plugins.name: maybloom-stack
plugins.description: Agent skills for the maybloom stack: bootstrap a proto-first Connect-RPC monorepo and add resources end-to-end through every layer. Validated TypeScript and Go paths ship in full; a language-neutral core reference supports any other Connect-RPC implementation. Includes the builder, mechanic, reviewer and orchestrator agents and the delegation skill that says which role does what, plus a status-line skill that installs the team's Claude Code status line (usage windows, the model-scoped weekly limit, context).
